title: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Standard Offer Contract for Interruptible City-Gate Gas Supply with Munksjo Paper Incorporated d/b/a Munksjo.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
filings: Memorandum to Service List. Re; Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company. By Hearing Officer, John Keene. DTE 05-GC-18

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds tha the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. The Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Brian Paul Golden. (D.T.E. 06-GC-18)
